changelog: The update check was audited end to end and made reliable and verifiable. Checks now always read the version file exactly as published right now, so the file host's five-minute cache can no longer hand the app an outdated copy right after an edit, and the file is read more tolerantly, so a version number accidentally saved as quoted text or a stray mark left by a web editor no longer fails the check. Leftover records from older versions of the update flow are cleaned up once per upgrade, a marker left behind by an install that never finished no longer costs that launch its update check, and every check records what it decided in the log. Check for updates now answers with the evidence: when nothing newer exists, it names the version installed on your device and the version the server reported, so you can see at a glance that both sides agree.
